verses.source: 11 Let a woman learn in silence with all submission.
verses.independently_reparsed_witness: Let a woman learn in silence with all submission.

verses.source: 12 And I do not permit a woman to teach or to have authority over a man, but to be in silence.
verses.independently_reparsed_witness: And  I do not permit a woman to teach or to have authority over a man, but to be in silence.

verses.source: 13 For Adam was formed first, then Eve.
verses.independently_reparsed_witness: For Adam was formed first, then Eve.

verses.source: 14 And Adam was not deceived, but the woman being deceived, fell into transgression.
verses.independently_reparsed_witness: And Adam was not deceived, but the woman being deceived, fell into transgression.

verses.source: 15 Nevertheless she will be saved in childbearing if they continue in faith, love, and holiness, with self-control.
verses.independently_reparsed_witness: Nevertheless she will be saved in childbearing if they continue in faith, love, and holiness, with self-control.

verses.source: 1 This is a faithful saying: If a man desires the position of a bishop, he desires a good work.
verses.independently_reparsed_witness: This  is  a faithful saying: If a man desires the position of a  bishop, he desires a good work.

verses.source: 2 A bishop then must be blameless, the husband of one wife, temperate, sober-minded, of good behavior, hospitable, able to teach;
verses.independently_reparsed_witness: A bishop then must be blameless, the husband of one wife, temperate, sober-minded, of good behavior, hospitable, able to teach;

verses.source: 3 not given to wine, not violent, not greedy for money, but gentle, not quarrelsome, not covetous;
verses.independently_reparsed_witness: not  given to wine, not violent,  not greedy for money, but gentle, not quarrelsome, not  covetous;

verses.source: 4 one who rules his own house well, having his children in submission with all reverence
verses.independently_reparsed_witness: one who rules his own house well, having  his  children in submission with all reverence

verses.source: 5 (for if a man does not know how to rule his own house, how will he take care of the church of God?);
verses.independently_reparsed_witness: (for if a man does not know how to rule his own house, how will he take care of the church of God?);

verses.source: 6 not a novice, lest being puffed up with pride he fall into the same condemnation as the devil.
verses.independently_reparsed_witness: not a  novice, lest being puffed up with pride he fall into the  same  condemnation as the devil.

verses.source: 7 Moreover he must have a good testimony among those who are outside, lest he fall into reproach and the snare of the devil.
verses.independently_reparsed_witness: Moreover he must have a good testimony among those who are outside, lest he fall into reproach and the  snare of the devil.
